commands.name: /ilokesto-scope
commands.description: Explain a package's scope and comparable open-source libraries. Usage: /ilokesto-scope <package-name>

commands.name: /ilokesto-release
commands.description: Add a changeset or trigger a release for the current package. Usage: /ilokesto-release [patch|minor|major] <summary>

commands.name: /ilokesto-docs-sync
commands.description: Trigger a docs sync PR from the current package to ilokesto/docs. Usage: /ilokesto-docs-sync

commands.name: /ilokesto-impact
commands.description: Analyze how a change in one package affects dependent packages. Usage: /ilokesto-impact <package-name>

commands.name: /ilokesto-onboard
commands.description: Create scaffolding for a new ilokesto package. Usage: /ilokesto-onboard <package-name>
